basic_info.description: Location, location, location delivered perfectly to you at the Jackson Towers.  In the heart of Pacific Heights, one of San Francisco's most sought after neighborhoods, comes an upgraded and excellent layout for the San Francisco work/ life balance.  Jackson Towers is sought out for its location AND its ideal layouts and grand living and bedding spaces.  This condo is a luxury 2 Bedroom each having its own bath.   It has a great room and elevator!   In addition, Jackson Towers features a panoramic roof deck and secure building with on-site management. You will love that all the luxury urban amenities are close by with Lafayette Park, the Fillmore District and Polk Street all just outside your door.
